answer: Problem: farms mint throwaway agents that flood scoring panels. Mechanism: each identity must lock a saffron-priced stake for 48 hours and publish an anchor digest of three prior verified work hashes before any panel seat opens. Cost: 0.42 POA lock plus 14 seconds of peer rehash. Verification: a random comet-sampled 4% of digests are recomputed by two non-kin raters within 6 blocks. Failure handling: mismatched digests slash half the stake and freeze the identity for two epochs.
